_comment: Density and conversion factors for BOQ mass estimation. ALL values are [E] estimates unless marked [V]. Engineer can override any value in the UI. Missing factor → exclude from gap denominator and list in missingFactors.

m3.note: Multiply by density factor to get mass

m2.note: Multiply by thickness × density to get mass. Thickness must be parsed from description or entered by user.

m.note: Cannot convert to mass without cross-section; exclude from denominator [MISSING_MASS_FACTOR]

nos.note: Cannot convert to mass without unit weight; exclude from denominator [MISSING_MASS_FACTOR]

lean_concrete.note: [E] Lean concrete (1:4:8 and similar) bulk density estimate. Confirm with civil engineer.

plain_concrete.note: [E] Plain cement concrete density estimate (standard value widely used). Confirm grade-specific value with structural engineer.

reinforced_concrete.note: [E] RCC density estimate. Steel reinforcement adds ~2–3%; using 2.4 t/m³ as conservative estimate.

masonry_plaster_sand.note: [E] Sand density estimate (loose bulk density ~1.6 t/m³). Confirm with site engineer.

pavers.note: [E] Paver blocks: default 80mm thickness × 2.4 t/m³ = 0.192 t/m². Thickness MUST be parsed from description (e.g. '80mm thick') or entered by user; default only if not found.

tiles.note: [E] Ceramic tiles: default 12mm thickness × 2.2 t/m³ = 0.0264 t/m². Parse from description; default only if not found.

aggregateFractions._comment: What fraction of concrete volume is aggregate (coarse + fine). Used to derive aggregate mass from concrete volume. [A] These fractions are assumptions — confirm with civil mentor (D11 decision).

lean_concrete.note: [A] Lean concrete: aggregate fraction ~0.75 of concrete volume. Divyansh approves; mentor reviews.

plain_concrete.note: [A] PCC: aggregate fraction ~0.65. Standard mix design assumption.

reinforced_concrete.note: [A] RCC: aggregate fraction ~0.65. Standard mix design assumption.
